items.name: G-FLOW Smartphone
items.desc: A trendy brick phone for so-called creatives. The camera's good, but the battery's a piece of junk.

items.name: D-MAX Smartphone
items.desc: Every other person has a phone like this. A stolen one would be dirt cheap.

items.name: P-Verse Smartphone
items.desc: A real workhorse. The battery holds a charge for so long, it'll probably wait for me to get out of jail.

items.name: Flip Ring Smartphone
items.desc: Bends in half. Gimmicky technology for the sake of flexing. The screen will crack if you look at it wrong.

items.name: Tuver Phone
items.desc: A fusion of high-quality metal and ambition. A phone for those who only receive calls and don't make them themselves.

items.name: GUDDI Earrings
items.desc: Vintage gold. They look like something your grandmother would leave you as an inheritance. Weigh quite a bit too.

items.name: AMINA Earrings
items.desc: These stones are worth more than my life. Let's hope I'll make it to the fence alive.

items.name: SUGI Earrings
items.desc: Sharp angles and geometry. Fashionable, and most importantly, the gold is of good quality.

items.name: MAFFI Earrings
items.desc: Exquisite craftsmanship. The design makes them expensive to buy at the store, but I will have to sell them by scrap weight. What a shame.

items.name: CHIPARDI Earrings
items.desc: Look like hairpins, but they're, in fact, platinum. The white stones are cold to the touch.

items.name: MEKASSI Earrings
items.desc: Two white sparks at the tips. Not crown jewels, but worth a pretty penny.

items.name: PEGIUET Watch
items.desc: Simple strap, reliable mechanism. Swiss precision for those who value their time.

items.name: CONSTERAN Watch
items.desc: A steel brick for your wrist. If the watch breaks, you can use it as a blunt weapon.

items.name: PARDIN Watch
items.desc: Made of some curious alloy. Lightweight, feels kind of strange. Lovers of the exotic will appreciate it.

items.name: NURDAN Watch
items.desc: An expensive skeleton watch. All the gears are visible. It's mesmerizing to watch them spin.

items.name: POLEX Watch
items.desc: You can't just buy a watch like this, they are passed down through generations... or stolen from someone too careless.

items.name: PENARAI Watch
items.desc: Rose gold. Looks flashy. Weighs a lot, though. Fences love this sort of thing.

items.name: ALON GIA Ring
items.desc: A simple silver ring with a green stone. Subtle yet easily turned into cash.

items.name: AMINA Ring
items.desc: A boring ring. It's the kind you usually take off during a divorce proceeding or a robbery.

items.name: GUDDI Ring
items.desc: A massive ring. Could knock someone's teeth out with it. The stone looks expensive.

items.name: SUGI Ring
items.desc: A chain for your finger. Looks strange, but it's golden and weighs quite a bit.

items.name: MAFFI Ring
items.desc: An animalistic grin made of gold. For those who want to appear dangerous.

items.name: PRIDE Ring
items.desc: The stone shimmers with a pink hue like expensive champagne. It costs so much that I'm afraid to hold it in my hands.

items.name: WISH Ring
items.desc: You don't see a ring like this every day. It's hard to even imagine how much people will pay for it.

items.name: ALON GIA Necklace
items.desc: A silver thread with pearls on it. Fragile. The pearls scratch easily, so handle with care.

items.name: GUDDI Necklace
items.desc: Has a Greek ornament on it. Heavy. Looks like a museum piece. Hope it's not costume jewelry.

items.name: MAFFI Necklace
items.desc: A niche item, but it will quickly find its buyer.

items.name: REFIER Necklace
items.desc: The stones are actually very small, but if you don't look too closely, it will pass for a treasure.

items.name: CHIPARDI Necklace
items.desc: A blue noose. It has so many sapphires it will weigh down your neck.

items.name: PENARAI Necklace
items.desc: The diamonds are dazzling. I could buy half the city with a necklace like this.

items.name: AIR-P Laptop

items.name: UTAB Laptop
items.desc: A tablet that desperately wants to be a laptop. A fragile toy for office clerks.

items.name: HUBRID Laptop
items.desc: Can't tell whether it's a tablet or a laptop. A weird hybrid, but the screen looks nice.

items.name: PD STATION Laptop
items.desc: Heavy, armored, encrypted. Can be sold, but not hacked.

items.name: MSR PRO Laptop
items.desc: Glows like a Christmas tree. Powerful, heavy, expensive.

items.name: SUS VILO Laptop
items.desc: Has a stylish case. Looks powerful and fast. Hope the data can be erased quickly too.

items.name: Key-Ten-Do Console
items.desc: A portable time killer. Great for staying awake during a long stakeout.

items.name: X-STATION Console
items.desc: Has a stylish white case. It glows too brightly in the dark, though, which is bad news for a thief.

items.name: ZTX Console
items.desc: New generation. It's a scarce item, which is why gamers would sell their souls to the devil for it.

items.name: G-Cube Console
items.desc: Limited edition. A gold mine for scalpers.

items.name: X-STATION VR Console
items.desc: A virtual reality headset. People put it on but forget to lock their doors. Which is convenient.

items.name: Krystal Light Bottle

items.name: Diamond Breeze Bottle

items.name: Happy Forester Bottle

items.name: Eclipse Bottle

items.name: Old Pocket Bottle

items.name: Amber Shift Bottle

items.name: Goodhouse Toaster

items.name: HELGRIM Comic Book
items.desc: Pictures of wussies in tights. Kind of lame, but the first edition costs serious money.

items.name: TADASHI Comic Book
items.desc: A ninja comic book. Geeks' favorite pulp fiction.

items.name: DIGITAL SOUL Comic Book

items.name: MASK Comic Book

items.name: VERSIA Magazine

items.name: AURORA MODE Magazine

items.name: VELVET RIOT Magazine
items.desc: A billionaire's widow on the cover. Or a murderer. In our world, that's often the same thing.

items.name: OPALINE Magazine

items.name: SuperDryer Hairdryer
items.desc: It takes talent to sell hot air for such a pile of cash.

items.name: HD X900 Graphics Card

items.name: RG 7700 Graphics Card

items.name: AIRHEADS Headphones

items.name: MS MIC Headphones
items.desc: A microphone, LED, a cheap plastic body. Some people like it.

items.name: DS MAX Headphones
items.desc: A huge headset. Cancels the noise of the police siren. Looks expensive.

items.name: OMEGA Headphones
items.desc: They fit so comfortably, I don't even want to take them off and sell them... but I have to.

items.name: Beat Head Headphones
items.desc: A premium class device. The leather is softer than our officer’s temper.

steps.title: Before the run: get a legendary drill
steps.text: The drill can be traded for at the Barter secret door in the hub. Click the drill to open its recipe and the ways to get the ingredients.

steps.title: At the bank: open the vault door
steps.text: Requires a large drill. Placing it takes 5 seconds; the door takes 60 seconds to breach according to the description. The state of the vault and the lobby conditions may affect availability.

steps.title: Open the inner door of the gold vault
steps.text: Requires the gold vault's ID Card. It is obtained at the hub's Barter for one filled set of bank deposit box keys. Click the ID Card: the chain shows buying an empty set and filling it to 60 points.

steps.title: In the vault: take the gold
steps.text: Seven unlocked nodes are confirmed in the gold vault: 1 bar per action, 9 actions per node. You don't need a Mini Drill to collect the nodes themselves. One more separate bar is elsewhere in the bank; whether it requires the inner ID Card has not been established.

items.name: Diamond in Case
items.desc: When I look at it, I don't see the refraction of light, but my comfortable life on a tropical island.

items.name: Topaz in Case
items.desc: Icy blue. Not as expensive as a diamond, but costs enough to last a lifetime.

items.name: Ruby in Case
items.desc: A blood-red stone. Looks sinister, but the price is nice.

items.name: Emerald in Case
items.desc: Green like dollars. My favorite color.

items.name: Amethyst in Case
items.desc: A purple stone. I could use it, but I'd rather sell it.

items.name: INFINITY Perfume
items.desc: The smell of money and parties. Awfully long-lasting. I'll suffocate if it breaks in my bag.

items.name: FLERS Perfume
items.desc: Has a very strong scent. The trail is so long-lasting you could track down the owner from a mile away.

items.name: TRIO Perfume
items.desc: A classic fragrance. This is what the bankers I usually rob smell like.

items.name: LACROCAS Perfume
items.desc: Flowery water for people with delicate sensibilities. It's expensive, and the bottle is heavy.

items.name: DUCHEE Perfume
items.desc: An elegant bottle. Contains alcohol and aromatic compounds on the inside and an aura of luxury on the outside.

items.name: Platinum Disc
items.desc: Someone worked like a dog their whole life for this disc, and all I needed to do to get it was some lighthearted B&E. Life's unfair, isn't it?

items.name: Golden Disc
items.desc: Someone's ego, framed under glass. No point in hanging it on the wall. Better find a collector with cash to spare and sell it to them.

items.name: Burex Condoms
items.desc: Cheap condoms. Use at your own risk.

items.name: Context Condoms
items.desc: All stuff and no fluff. Protection for a matter of minutes.

items.name: Zipit Condoms
items.desc: In and out. For those who are always in a rush.

items.name: LUX Condoms
items.desc: As thin as my wallet after an encounter with a police officer. Can barely feel them.

items.name: Playgirl Condoms
items.desc: The best you can buy. Or steal.

items.name: Eason McKinley Card
items.desc: The Holy Grail. Don't breathe on it and don't bend the corners. This is my retirement plan right here.

items.name: Damon Strickland Card
items.desc: The rookie of the season. Worth mere pennies for now, but who knows?

items.name: Maxwell Rivers Card
items.desc: A perfectly average player. Nothing special, but the fans will buy it anyway.

items.name: Trent Carver Card
items.desc: I remember the scandal involving this guy. A dirty reputation always raises the price.

items.name: Bradley Sanderson Card
items.desc: You can buy a used car for the same price as this piece of cardboard.

items.name: Harley Wanger Card
items.desc: Just junk to me, but a fortune to a collector.

items.name: Poker Powerplay Deck
items.desc: Slick cards. Perfect for dealing yourself an ace from your sleeve.

items.name: Mystic Card Chronicles Deck
items.desc: The card back serves as a distraction. While someone is busy examining the patterns, you're picking their pockets.

items.name: Ace's Dominion Deck
items.desc: Worn cards. They were played with in every basement in the city. Probably marked.

items.name: Bad Habit Deck
items.desc: A loser's deck. Better keep your hand on your holster if you see it on the table.

items.name: Joker's Choice Deck
items.desc: A collector's dream. If sealed, it's worth more than the pot in a high rollers' game.

items.name: Powder
items.desc: Strong, expensive stuff. Apparently, not for baking.

items.name: Loose Leaves
items.desc: Brewed at a temperature of 420 degrees Fahrenheit.

items.name: Vitamin E
items.desc: A popular confidence booster.

items.name: Sugar
items.desc: Makes criminal life a little sweeter.

items.name: Chewing Gum
items.desc: Sharpens your mind.

items.name: Brick
items.desc: Looks like a construction block, but you won't be able to build a house with it. It will, however, blow the roof of your mind off.

items.name: Candy
items.desc: Candy for those who really want to go breaking bad.

items.name: Drill
items.desc: A tool for breaking into Bank Vaults. Takes a lot of time to do its job and is very noisy.
items.alert: When the breach of the bank vault door begins, the whole city finds out.

items.name: Mini Drill
items.desc: Compact and precise. Quickly cracks safe locks.

items.name: Deity Statue
items.desc: Looks quite friendly. I hope it'll bring me luck in the form of cash.

items.name: Golden Cat Statue
items.desc: Heavy, tasteless, and made entirely of gold. My favorite cat breed.

items.name: Wooden Figure
items.desc: Looks like art, burns like firewood. I won't get much money for it.

items.name: Stone Maiden Statue
items.desc: The face is ugly, but it's got some nice embellishments. Antique collectors would kill for this.

items.name: Wooden Totem
items.desc: A cheap copy for tourists. The only scary thing about it is its poor quality.

items.name: Copper Pitcher
items.desc: A fake antique. It's buried underground for a week to be foisted on experts.

items.name: CollectiToy #1 Figure
items.desc: It stood on the shelf and watched me rob the apartment. Now it's going to gawk at the fence.

items.name: CollectiToy #2 Figure
items.desc: The red series. Differs from the basic version only in plastic color and the inflated price.

items.name: CollectiToy #3 Figure
items.desc: A black-and-white, "noir" version of a toy figure. Looks depressing, costs a lot.

items.name: CollectiToy #4 Figure
items.desc: A kid in a cap. Limited edition. Geeks would kill for this plastic toy.

items.name: CollectiToy x TA
items.desc: Made in collaboration with a fashion designer. He just slapped his name on it, and the price skyrocketed.

items.name: Snap-Snap Lighter
items.desc: Just a lighter. There's one like this in every pocket.

items.name: Lerrou Lighter
items.desc: The case is nice, but the fence would know it's a cheapo.

items.name: RedOlive Lighter
items.desc: Red and flashy. Losing it is easy, but finding a new owner for it is a piece of cake too.

items.name: Clipper Lighter
items.desc: A classic with an imprint. I could use it as currency if I wanted to.

items.name: SkyDragon Lighter
items.desc: A fire-breathing dragon. Tacky, but rich kids love stuff like this.

items.name: Lucky Shot Cigarettes
items.desc: Rough on the throat like sandpaper. The choice for those who can't afford decent tobacco.

items.name: Old Huba Cigars
items.desc: Greasy, smelly, expensive. They reek of power and corruption.

items.name: KeKe Cigarettes
items.desc: It's not exactly a cheap habit. It's a good thing you can sell them for good money.

items.name: Vial With Supplements
items.desc: Watered-down syrup. Looks like colored tap water.

items.name: Vial With Liquid
items.desc: A medicine for the wealthy. It will save your life if you have money.

items.name: Vial With Vaccine
items.desc: Liquid immunity. People will kill for this vial if an epidemic breaks out.

items.name: Vial With Rare Medicine
items.desc: A murky goop. Could be medicine, could be poison. Not going to test it on myself.

items.name: Cosmetic Ampule
items.desc: Face goop. Costs a fortune, but it's basically just water and grease.

items.name: Medicinal Ampule
items.desc: There are a lot of zeros on the price tag. That means someone really needs it.

items.name: Vial With Illegal Drug
items.desc: Banned in half of all countries. A rare but dangerous find.

items.name: Heavy Body Armor
items.desc: Standard heavy body armor.

items.name: Bastion Body Armor
items.desc: Advanced assault body armor for extended combat operations.

items.name: Painkillers
items.desc: A strong medication with an immediate effect.

items.name: Painkillers
items.desc: A strong medication with an immediate effect.

items.name: AFAK
items.desc: A personal tactical first aid kit.

items.name: Laser Rangefinder
items.desc: Measures distance with a laser. I won't even bother figuring out how to use it and just sell it.

items.name: Binoculars
items.desc: Optics for seeing far away. But I rely on my own eyesight and intuition.

items.name: Thermal Imager
items.desc: Allows you to see heat through walls. Worth the money, but too complex for me to handle.

items.name: Field Ration
items.desc: Food wrapped in plastic. Tastes like cardboard but doesn't spoil for years.

items.name: Powerful Flashlight
items.desc: Has a heavy metal body. Too bad the batteries are dead.

items.name: K9 Body Armor
items.desc: Armor for man's best friend. Even dogs need protection in Looty Bay.

items.name: Modern Tactical Binoculars
items.desc: Elite tactical optics. Useless in combat, but fences will gladly transform this into cash.

items.name: Tactical Binoculars
items.desc: Solid lenses. My future isn't bright enough to warrant these, but mercenaries consistently pay good money for them.

items.name: Tactical Multitool
items.desc: Reliable steel. I've got enough tools already, but some extra cash wouldn't hurt. Sell it.

items.name: Premium Multitool
items.desc: Perfect build. Too expensive for dirty work, but can be sold at an excellent price.

items.name: Collectible Multitool
items.desc: A custom piece. If I break one part, I'll lose a fortune. Needs to be sold to a connoisseur, and fast.

items.name: Portable EW System
items.desc: I don't want to know what this thing is capable of. The main thing is that it costs an arm and a leg.

items.name: Camping Stove
items.desc: It hisses and smokes half of the time. A heavy piece of junk that will bring me some loose change at best.

items.name: Field Stove
items.desc: Steady flame. I've warmed up my food already, and this thing is easy to turn into quick cash.

items.name: High-precision Stove
items.desc: Fine flame adjustment. Clog the delicate nozzle and you'll lose a ton of money. Better sell it to the experts right away.

items.name: Gun Cleaning Kit
items.desc: A cleaning rod and some gun grease. Cleaning the barrel is tedious, but life is more important than being lazy.

items.name: Professional Gun Cleaning Kit
items.desc: A whole suitcase full of tools. For those who love their gun more than their mother.

items.name: Tactical Gun Cleaning Kit
items.desc: Professional chemicals and brushes. If I break the seal, it will lose its value. Better sell it as is.

items.name: Gun Grease
items.desc: Keep the barrel well-oiled, or it'll jam at the worst possible moment. That's the law of the streets.

items.name: Professional Gun Grease
items.desc: My gun can do without it, and a sealed can is easily turned into cash.

items.name: Synthetic Gun Grease
items.desc: Top-grade composition. It'd be a crying shame to waste on my own gun. Better sell it to some artisan for a hefty sum.

items.name: Imperial Collectible Knife
items.desc: D2 steel. Cuts perfectly. So beautiful I don't even want to use it.

items.name: Aeron Collectible Knife
items.desc: Titanium and swag. Too clean for my work, better to sell it.

items.name: Streamline Collectible Knife
items.desc: Nothing but the essentials. Easy to hide in a boot. A valuable item for sale.

items.name: Cyber Collectible Knife
items.desc: Has a carbon blade. Looks like a prop from a sci-fi movie.

items.name: Nightfall Collectible Knife
items.desc: It's not just a weapon, but a piece of art. I'll hit the jackpot if I don't ruin the packaging.

items.name: Shade Collectible Knife
items.desc: You can tell right away that it's handmade. A knife like this is valued for more than just its sharpness.

items.name: Fluffy Handcuffs
items.desc: A bedroom toy. The fur is soft, the metal is sturdy. Don't ask me where I got these.

items.name: Exotic Tool
items.desc: A weird-looking thing. Seems dangerous. Maybe it's for torture, or maybe for something else.

items.name: Royal Motors Emblem
items.desc: I often see cars of this brand in the city, but none have this emblem.

items.name: Car Headlight
items.desc: Blindingly bright. Better sell it.

items.name: Jack
items.desc: A heavy piece of metal. Can lift a car, but I prefer to use car lifts.

items.name: DW-04
items.desc: Gets rid of hinge squeak. I should sell it to someone who repairs doors after I break them.

items.name: Steering Wheel
items.desc: Hopefully, the airbag is intact. The thing wasn't easy to remove, but the demand for those is insane.

items.name: Spark Plugs
items.desc: They might seem small, but you won't get very far without them. It certainly can't hurt to have a spare one.

items.name: Car Compressor
items.desc: A well-built air compressor. A useful thing all around. Won't be hard to find a buyer for it.

items.name: Premium Car Compressor
items.desc: An expensive model. People usually buy one of those just once, and it lasts a long time.

items.name: Hanging Dice
items.desc: A common car accessory. It doesn't cost much, but it does have character.

items.name: Air Freshener
items.desc: It smells better than most cars I've been in.

items.name: Car Perfume
items.desc: It's a small thing, but nice scents are always in demand.

items.name: Racer Keychain
items.desc: Just a trinket, but car enthusiasts have their own opinions on things like this.

items.name: Pit Bull Bobblehead
items.desc: A funny-looking figurine. I'm sure I can find someone who'd want to put it on their dash.

items.name: Plush Car Charm
items.desc: Some people like decorating their car interior with plushies like this. Who am I to judge?

items.name: Affordable Dashcam
items.desc: A simple dashcam. It's not the best, but it's definitely worth the money.

items.name: Cheap Car Stereo
items.desc: Just a regular car stereo. I'm sure there's someone out there who could use one.

items.name: Dashcam

items.name: Car Stereo

routes.title: An exhibit in the Art Gallery

steps.title: Before the run: get a Glass Cutter
steps.text: The Glass Cutter can be traded for at the Barter secret door in the hub for 3 filled Code Tablets. Click the Glass Cutter to open its recipe and the way to fill the tablets.

steps.title: At the gallery: take the exhibit
steps.text: The Glass Cutter lets you steal the exhibit and is used up in the process. The gallery vault Keycard isn't needed. Taking it takes 2 seconds.
